archived_contexto.label: Morcov
archived_contexto.original_reason: Morcov is common, concrete, and unambiguous, but only Legume and Mâncare are direct predecessors. Two direct neighbors cannot clear the literal five-neighbor C3 release floor; Iepure is only Rece and no projection or proxy repairs the sparse target neighborhood.

archived_contexto.label: A citi
archived_contexto.original_reason: A citi is a familiar action with well-covered inflections and Carte as an obvious opener, but the strict target ontology excludes verbs and its three direct predecessors also miss C3.

archived_contexto.label: Drepturile omului
archived_contexto.original_reason: Drepturile omului is recognizable and densely connected, but it is an abstract legal framework rather than a concrete, spontaneously nameable secret. A civics vocabulary field does not rescue the hard C1 failure.

archived_contexto.label: Recensământul populației
archived_contexto.original_reason: Recensământul populației is the rubric's explicit canonical C1 kill: a record/meta-process rather than a concrete secret. Populație and Stat are warm, but difficulty cannot come from asking the player to name an institutional phrase.

archived_contexto.label: familie
archived_contexto.original_reason: Familie is common and numerically dense, so the inventory verifier proposed promotion. The gameplay analyst found the decisive counterexample: Mamă, Tată, Bunică, Bunic, Frate, and Soră all rank 2,079/2,288 and read Înghețat while Weekend and broad civic abstractions are one-hop hot. That misleading core gradient blocks unanimous promotion and fail-closed synthesis rejects the exact record.

archived_contexto.label: Farmacie
archived_contexto.original_reason: Farmacie has six safe non-winning medical projections and therefore obvious openers, but its only direct KG predecessors are the generic place siblings Parc and Magazin. Projection rank-2 hints cannot substitute for the literal five-neighbor C3 target floor.

archived_contexto.label: Sonicitate
archived_contexto.original_reason: Sonicitate is the rubric's canonical obscure meta-concept kill, has only four direct predecessors, and is the batch's sole salience warning at 0.152 below the greu floor of 0.20. Fizică being warm cannot turn obscurity into fair difficulty.

archived_contexto.label: Ploaie
archived_contexto.original_reason: Ploaie is universal and Nor/Apă are obvious openers, but three direct predecessors fail C3. Its natural definite form ploaia already resolves to the served Cargo song node, so it cannot safely be added as a weather alias or projection.

archived_contexto.label: Frigider
archived_contexto.original_reason: Frigider is concrete and Bucătărie is an obvious opener, but its three direct predecessors include generic Lampă and Ușă. Congelator supplies one non-winning projected hint; the current target still misses the C3 density and legibility bar.

archived_contexto.label: Creion
archived_contexto.original_reason: Creion is concrete and Radieră/Caiet/Ghiozdan are excellent openers, but the exact target has only those three direct predecessors and no target-anchored projection or proxy. It remains a strong future repair candidate, not a release candidate.

archived_contexto.label: Făraș
archived_contexto.original_reason: Exact imported dossier has zero lint findings and its KG, rubric and record bindings are verified against current pending state. Zero deterministic findings cannot waive ADR-0071 or C3. My earlier raw keep was staging only and incorrectly treated the incoming/outgoing union as the five-neighbor floor; the original artifact is preserved and this final review corrects that interpretation. Reject ct_viata_de_roman_352 under C3: the dossier has only three direct recognizable predecessors, Podea, Aspirator and Mătură. Its five distinct adjacent objects include outgoing-only Mop and Burete de vase; those do not supply two more incoming cues. The separate exact Praf repair and several same-Podea-proxy guesses give useful hot feedback but ADR-0071 explicitly forbids substituting such a cluster for five direct predecessors. C1/C2/C5/C6 otherwise pass: Făraș is a concrete ordinary dustpan, dominant household sense, salience 0.90; old CADE and current Leifheit use support easy recognition without pretending to measure population knowledge. C4 has actual Mătură #4, Casă #9 and Praf/Podea #2 approaches,2,343 reachable / 250 responsive; the safe clue/repeat/resume/plural-win journey passes. A1–A7 otherwise show no adult, regional, stereotype or prior-target duplicate trigger. Nineteen of 33 deliberately broad surfaces remain unknown, including Gunoi/Murdărie/Pardoseală. Familiarity, one good dust route and successful technical completion cannot cure C3. Rejection removes this pending round through the supported apply tool; preserve its exact dossier and final judgment and require a reviewed topology repair before a future proposal. No graph padding is requested.

archived_contexto.label: Aspirator
archived_contexto.original_reason: Exact imported dossier has zero lint findings and its KG, rubric and record bindings are verified against current pending state. Zero deterministic findings cannot waive ADR-0071 or C3. My earlier raw keep was staging only and incorrectly treated the incoming/outgoing union as the five-neighbor floor; the original artifact is preserved and this final review corrects that interpretation. Reject ct_viata_de_roman_354 under C3: only three direct recognizable predecessors appear in the current directed dossier, Podea, Mop and Mătură. Outgoing-only Făraș and Burete de vase made the earlier adjacent-object count five; they cannot replace missing direct predecessors. Neither the Praf exact surface policy nor several Podea proxies constitutes new KG neighbors. C1/C2/C5/C6 otherwise pass for the ordinary household dust/floor/carpet appliance: DEX 1998 and current Kärcher usage support recognition, domestic sense dominates despite qualified industrial/nasal variants, salience 0.94. C4 has actual Casă #12/warm, Covor #36/warm, Mătură #4/hot and Praf/Podea #2/hot;2,343 reachable / 358 responsive and the clue/repeat/resume/plural-win journey pass. A1–A7 otherwise show no adult, stereotype, region or existing-target duplicate trigger. Electricitate #378/cold, Apă #9/hot and unknown Filtru/Sac/Păr de animale remain quality costs; water is not claimed as universal for dry vacuums. The good dust route does not satisfy the absent C3 topology. Supported reject removes this pending record; preserve immutable review evidence and require a separately reviewed topology repair before any future target proposal.
